entries.562884818f951e91: This division develops, designs, manufactures and sells the 'Alpha Frame System,' an aluminum alloy structural member that forms the basic frame of machinery and equipment, together with ＦＡ equipment using it (cleaning, inspection, conveying and packaging equipment), clean booths, etc. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,017 million.
entries.58fc22a6e4ea694f: Its main product is the “Alpha Frame System,” an aluminum alloy structural member assembled only with bolts without welding, and the company offers more than 2,200 types of products. The company also provides ＦＡ equipment and clean booths that use these as basic components.
entries.61b6b42bb1eaa0e2: Because the business description states that Alpha Frame is used in structures such as ＦＡ equipment, clean booths and machine covers, and Canon Inc. is shown as a customer for the current business year in related information such as segment information (information by major customer).

entries.64db4773bcff8821: Customers are factories in a wide range of manufacturing industries, starting with the automotive field and including semiconductors, electronic components, pharmaceuticals and food. Sales to Canon Inc., a major customer, are made through the ＦＡ Division.
entries.676cb7a5dd61a469: It owns aluminum frames, which form the base components of ＦＡ equipment, under its own brand, and its position rests on transactions with large manufacturing customers; for example, Canon Inc. is disclosed as a customer for the current business year in the information by major customer.

entries.818a13693ed893ee: A system consisting of an aluminum alloy structural member, 'Alpha Frame,' and auxiliary parts such as brackets, bolts and nuts; it can be assembled with bolts alone, without welding. It offers more than 2,200 types of products and also takes orders for frames with custom cross-sectional shapes for individual customers. It also provides design and assembly support services: 'Kakucha,' automatic design support using 3-dimensional ＣＡＤ, and a 'marking system' that prints assembly instructions directly onto the frames.
